digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: Bridge has no store-level mapping to record which tracker projects a store syncs and which repos each project's tickets belong to, causing per-repo subsets against a shared snapshot to diff as remote deletions

A new projects_store.py module must expose load_mapping(repo_root) to read and validate .bridge_state/projects.json, and resolve_project(ticket, mapping) as a pure tri-state rule returning legacy_default for absent fields, None for explicit empty, or the project key itself

bridge projects subcommand (list/set/remove verbs) must be added to CLI with help text in bridge.txt, library parity in _lib_ops.py, and MCP parity splitting list (read tool, READ_ONLY) from set/remove (write tools)
The set verb requires --repos argument (non-zero exit if omitted) and replaces rather than merges repos lists; set --repos "" stores an empty list and set without --repos raises an argument error
An absent projects.json record reads as legal empty mapping with None legacy_default; a malformed record raises rather than degrading
Mapping writes must leave bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json byte-identical; removal of unknown keys and writes across all three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) must be cross-verified as byte-equal
